tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// dpal rdo rje sder mo'i gzungs bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra ra ti ru nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje sder mo zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das rdo rje zom gyi khang pa na/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun grangs med pa rnams dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rig pa 'dzin pa rnams la bka' stsal pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa rnams nyon cig /dpal rdo rje sder mo zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de ni bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras mo/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lcam mo// khro bo rnams kyi yum/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gtso mo/ rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi grogs mo// bstan pa srung ba'i mnga' bdag /dkon mchog gsum gyi srung ma/ dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ bdud dang mu stegs thams cad sgrol bar byed pa'i mnga' bdag yin no// rig pa 'dzin pa gang gis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i gzungs sngags 'di rjes su bzung nas bzlas brjod bgyis na/ legs pa'i yon tan bco lnga dang ldan par 'gyur te/ bco lnga po gang zhe na/ gnas gang dang gang du skyes kyang chos skyong ba'i rgyal po dang 'phrad pa dang*/ sdig pa mi byed pa'i yul du skye ba dang*/ rtag tu dus bzang po dang phrad pa dang*/ rtag tu dge ba'i grogs po rnams dang 'grogs pa dang*/ dbang po dang yan lag tshang ba dang*/ spyod lam rnam pa bzhi dul ba dang*/ tshul khrims dang dam tshig nyams pa med par 'gyur ba dang*/ mchod rdzas dang 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnams gzhan gyis mi 'phrog par 'gyur ba dang*/ rtag tu mi gzhan rnams kyis bkur bsti dang phu dud du byed par 'gyur ba dang*/ nor rdzas dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ba dang*/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyis mgon skyabs byed par 'gyur ba dang*/

rtag tu dge ba'i bshes dang 'phrad par 'gyur ba dang*/ chos thos nas sgrub pa nyams su len par 'gyur ba ste/ legs pa'i yon tan rnam pa bco lnga dang ldan par 'gyur ro// gzhan yang gshis ngan du 'chi ba rnam pa bco lnga myong bar mi 'gyur te/ de gang zhe na/ mu ge byung nas ltogs te mi 'chi/ mtshon cha dang lcags kyu rgyab nas mi 'chi/ dmag drangs pa'i g.yul du mi 'chi/ stag dang gcan zan rnams kyis mi gsod/ chus khyer nas mi 'chi/ mes 'tshig nas mi 'chi/ dug blud nas mi 'chi/ 'byung po rnams kyis mi gsod/ sems stor zhing snying myos pas mi 'chi/ ri'am shang ngam/ gad pa la lhung nas mi 'chi/ pha rol po'i byad stems kyis mi 'chi/ rims nad ngan pas mi 'chi/ rang gis lcebs te mi 'chi/ kha 'og tu bltas te mi 'chi/ thog babs te mi 'chi/ 'thab pa dang 'khrug pa med cing lag pa g.yab mo byed cing 'chi bar mi 'gyur ro// gzhan yang phan yon 'di rnams dang ldan par 'gyur te/ lus la nad mi 'byung zhing gal te las kyi dbang gis nad byung na yang myur du zhi bar 'gyur ba dang*/ skye bo mang po'i yid du 'ong ba dang*/ nor rnyed cing nor yod pa yang rkun mas khyer bar mi 'gyur ba dang*/ dgra'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba dang*/ rigs brgyud 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang*/ tshe ring bar 'gyur ba dang*/ mthu rtsal dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang*/ bla ma dam pa rnams la gus shing chos la longs spyod par 'gyur ba dang*/ sri dang mthu dang mi kha zug pa thams cad phyir bzlog par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas rgyun du srung ba dang*/ skyob pa dang*/ sbed par byed pa/ de'i phyir rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis gzungs sngags 'di 'bri bar bya'o// bcang bar bya'o// bklag par bya'o// kun chub par bya'o// tshul bzhin du yid la bya'o// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rma bya chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo// so sor 'brang ma chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo// bsil ba'i tshal chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo// gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag rgyal po'i 'jigs pa dang*/

chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa dang*/ me'i 'jigs pa dang*/ chu'i 'jigs pa dang*/ dug gi 'jigs pa dang*/ mtshon gyi 'jigs pa dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi 'jigs pa dang*/ mu ge'i 'jigs pa dang*/ dgra'i 'jigs pa dang*/ lce 'bab pa'i 'jigs pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dang*/ sa g.yo ba'i 'jigs pa dang*/ skar mda' ltung ba'i 'jigs pa dang*/ rgyal po'i chad pa'i 'jigs pa dang*/ lha'i 'jigs pa dang*/ klu'i 'jigs pa dang*/ glog gi 'jigs pa dang*/ nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa dang*/ gcan zan khro bo'i 'jigs pa dang*/ 'jigs pa de dag thams cad las bdag rgyal bar gyur cig /'jigs pa de dag thams cad rig sngags 'dis bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// tho bas brdung ngo*/ phyag rgyas mnan no// na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra nāṃ/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya gha tā ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya/ bdag gi 'jigs pa thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa phaṭa/ kī li ki lā ya phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra kī li ki lā ya badz+ra dha rod a dzñā pa ya ti kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra ki lā ya phaṭa/ oṃ a kro dhe ka mud+ga ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa bi dh+waṃ sa ya/ dza ṭi lam+bo dha ri u tsush+ma kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag la lha'i gdon dang*/ klu'i gdon dang*/ lha ma yin gyi gdon dang*/ rlung lha'i gdon dang*/ nam mkha' lding gi gdon dang*/ dri za'i gdon dang*/ mi'am ci'i gdon dang*/ lto 'phye chen po'i gdon dang*/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gdon dang*/ yi dwags kyi gdon dang*/ sha za'i gdon dang*/ 'byung po'i gdon dang*/ grul bum gyi gdon dang*/ srul po'i gdon dang*/ lus srul po'i gdon dang*/ skem byed kyi gdon dang*/ brjed byed kyi gdon dang*/ smyo byed kyi gdon dang*/ grib gnon gyi gdon dang*/ gnon pa'i gdon dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon dang*/ nam gru'i gdon dang*/

gshin rje'i gdon dang*/ bya'i gdon dang*/ ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon dang*/ kun tu 'gro ba'i gdon dang*/ tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon rnams las bdag rgyal bar gyur cing*// gdon de dag thams cad kyi ngan sems dang*/ gnod sems thams cad rig sngags 'dis bcad do// phur bus gad ba bo// tho bas brdung ngo*/ phyag rgyas mnan no// na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra nāṃ/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya gha tā ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa phaṭa/ ki li ki lā ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya/ badz+ra dha rod a dzñā pa ya ti/ kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra kī lī ki lā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kro dhe ka mud+ga ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na ha na/ da ha pa tsa bi dh+waṃ sa ya dza ṭi lam+bo dha ri u tsush+ma kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag gi mdangs dang gzi brjid 'phrog pa dang*/ zas su mngal za ba dang*/ zas su khrag 'thung ba dang*/ zas su zhag za ba dang*/ zas su sha za ba dang*/ zas su tshil za ba dang*/ zas su rkang za ba dang*/ zas su btsas pa za ba dang*/ srog 'phrog pa dang*/ zas su skyugs pa za ba dang*/ zas su mi gtsang ba za ba dang*/ zas su stor khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba dang*/ zas su lhag ma za ba dang*/ zas su mchil ma 'thung ba dang*/ zas su ngar snabs za ba dang*/ zas su rnag za ba dang*/ zas su gtor ma za ba dang*/ zas su 'phreng ba za ba dang*/ zas su dri za ba dang*/ zas su bdug pa za ba dang*/ sems 'phrog pa dang*/ zas su me tog za ba dang*/ zas su 'bras bu za ba dang*/ zas su lo tog za ba dang*/ zas su sbyin sreg za ba de dag thams cad las bdag rgyal bar gyur cig /de dag thams cad kyi ngan sems dang gnod sems thams cad rig sngags 'dis bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// tho bas brdung ngo*/ phyag rgyas mnan no// na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra nāṃ/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya ghā tā ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya/ bdag gi mdangs 'phrog pa dang*/

gzi brjid 'phrog pa thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa phaṭa/ kī li kī lā ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya/ badz+ra dha rod a dzñā pa ya ti kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra kī li kī lā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kro dhe ka mud+ga ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi dh+waṃ sa ya dza ṭi lam+bo dha ri u tsush+ma kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag la phur bus dbal sgril ba dang*/ ma mo'i thun zor 'phen pa dang*/ gshin rje'i 'khor lo skor ba dang*/ mu stegs kyis sngags rgod zlos pa dang*/ klu'i byad stems su 'jug pa dang*/ gnod sbyin gyis bod gtong gtong ba dang*/ bdud kyis drag sngags bod pa dang*/ mtshe zor dang nyung zor 'phen pa dang*/ mda' zor dang*/ kong zor dang*/ khrag zor dang*/ thun zor dang*/ chos zor dang*/ bon zor dang*/ bud med kyi dmod zor dang*/ skyes pa'i mda' zor la sogs pa de dag thams cad rig sngags 'dis bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// tho bas brdung ngo*/ phyag rgyas mnan no// na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra nāṃ/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya ghā tā ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya/ bdag la rig sngags kyi mthu gtong ba thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa phaṭa/ kī li kī lā ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya badz+ra dha rod a dzñā pa ya ti kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra kī li kī lā hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kro dhe ka mud+ga ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi dh+waṃ sa ya bi dh+waṃ sa ya/ dza ṭi lam+bo dha ri u tsush+ma kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag la rims nyin gcig pa dang*/ nyin gnyis pa dang*/ nyin gsum pa dang*/ nyin bzhi pa dang*/ nyin lnga pa dang*/ nyen drug pa dang*/ nyin bdun pa dang*/ zla ba phye pa dang*/ yud tsam pa dang*/ rtag pa'i rims rnams dang*/ rims ldang dub pa rnams dang*/ rims mi bzad pa rnams dang*/ rims drag po rnams dang*/ 'byung po'i rims rnams dang*/

khrag las gyur pa dang*/ rlung las gyur pa dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa dang*/ bad kan las gyur pa dang*/ 'dus pa las gyur pa dang*/ rims nad thams cad dang*/ klad pa na ba'i rims thams cad rig sngags 'dis bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// tho bas brdung ngo*// phyag rgyas mnan no// na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra nāṃ/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya gha tā ya sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya/ bdag gi rims nad thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa phaṭa/ kī li kī lā ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra kī lā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kro dha ka mud+ga ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi dh+waṃ sa ya bi dh+waṃ sa ya dza ṭi lam+bo dha ri u tsush+ma kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag gi lus thams cad na ba dang*/ gzhogs phyed na ba dang*/ yi ga 'chus pa dang*/ mig nad dang*/ sna nad dang*/ kha nad dang*/ mgul nad dang*/ snying nad dang*/ lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang*/ rna ba na ba dang*/ so na ba dang*/ snying na ba dang*/ klad pa na ba dang*/ rtsibs logs na ba dang*/ rgyab na ba dang*/ lto ba na ba dang*/ rked pa na ba dang*/ chu so na ba dang*/ brla na ba dang*/ rje ngar na ba dang*/ lag pa na ba dang*/ rkang pa na ba dang*/ yan lag na ba dang*/ nying lag na ba dang*/ bdag gi nad thams cad rig sngags 'dis bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// tho bas brdung ngo*/ phyag rgyas mnan no// na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra nāṃ/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya gha tā ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya/ bdag gi lus kyi nad thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa phaṭa/ kī li ki lā ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya badz+ra dha rod ā dzñāk+s+ya pa ya ti kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra ki lā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kro dha ka mud+ga ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi dh+waṃ sa ya bi dh+waṃ sa ya/ dza ṭi lam+bo dha ri u tsush+ma kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/

bdag la yul mi'i dgra bdo ba dang*/ pha tshan spun zla dang*/ zhang nye dang*/ mag skud dang*/ grogs po dang*/ bran khol dang*/ yaṃ skud dang*/ bu sring dang*/ khyim mtshes kyis dgra sdang ba thams cad rig sngags 'dis bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// tho bas brdung ngo*// phyag rgyas mnan no// na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra nāṃ/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya gha tā ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya/ bdag la snga dgra lag la brdar ba dang*/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa phaṭa/ kī li ki lā ya/ sarba pā paṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya/ badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra kī lā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kro dhe ka mud+ga ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi dh+waṃ sa ya/ dza ṭi lam+bo dha ri u tsush+ma kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag legs na mi dga' nyes na dga' ba dang*/ bdag bzang na mi dga' ngan na dga' ba dang*/ mtho na mi dga' dma' na dga' ba dang*/ grags na mi dga' ma grags na dga' ba dang*/ rnyed pa dang ldan na mi dga' mi ldan na dga' ba dang*/ bstod na mi dga' smad na dga' ba dang*/ yod na mi dga' med na dga' ba dang*/ bde na mi dga' sdug bsngal na dga' ba dang*/ gzhan gyis bkur sti byas na mi dga' ma byas na dga' ba dang*/ mthu rtsal dang ldan na mi dga' mi ldan na dga' ba dang*/ byams pa mang na mi dga' mi byams pa mang na dga' ba dang*/ 'khor phun sum tshogs na mi dga' 'khor med na dga' ba dang*/ bdag la chags sdang dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ mtho gnon byed pa thams cad rig sngags 'dis bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// tho bas brdung ngo*// phyag rgyas mnan no// na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra nāṃ/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya gha tā ye/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya/ bdag la mtho gnon dang*/ ngan sems dang*/ gnod sems 'dzin pa thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa phaṭa/ kī li kī lā ya sarba pā pa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/

badz+ra kī li kī lā ya/ badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra kī li kī lā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kro dhe ka mud+ga ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi dh+waṃ sa ya/ dza ṭi lam+bo dha ri u tsush+ma kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag la rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa dang*/ yas kyi bdud g.yos pa dang*/ mas kyi sri langs pa dang*/ bar gyi btsan khros pa dang*/ tshe la gnod pa dang*/ dpal la 'jab pa dang*/ rgyags la rku ba dang*/ 'khor la 'tshe ba dang*/ longs spyod dang bsod nams la gnod par byed pa dang*/ sems la sdug bsngal bskyed par byed pa thams cad rig sngags 'dis bcad do// phur bus gdab bo/ tho bas brdung ngo*/ phyag rgyas mnan no// na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra nāṃ/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya gha tā ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya/ bdag la rnam par 'tshe ba thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa phaṭa/ ki li kī lā ya/ sarba pā pa hūm̐ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya badz+ra dha rod ā dzñāk+s+ya pa ya ti/ kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra kī lā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kro dhe ka mud+ga ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi dh+waṃ sa ya/ dza ṭi lam+bo dha ri u tsush+ma kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag la mi kha ngan pa smra ba dang*/ phra ma ngan pa 'jug pa dang*/ byur dang skal yugs 'gel ba dang*/ mtho gong du bsgral ba dang*/ dma' bab par 'bebs pa dang*/ sde chen la snyegs pa dang*/ 'phrang chen la sgug pa dang*/ phyi'i zhing la gnod pa dang*/ phugs kyi nor la rku ba dang*/ sgo'i phyugs la gnod pa dang*/ mchan gyi bu la gnod pa dang*/ gtan gyi grogs la gnod par byed pa thams cad rig sngags 'dis bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// tho bas brdung ngo*/ phyag rgyas mnan no// na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra nāṃ/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya gha tu ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya/ bdag la sdang ba'i dgra dang*/

gnod pa'i bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa phaṭa/ kī li ki lā ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya/ badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra kī lā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kro dhe ka mud+ga ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi dh+waṃ sa ya/ dza ṭi lam+bo dha ri u tsush+ma kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku la bsdo ba dang*/ mched lcam dral yongs la 'tshe ba dang*/ bdag gi lus la bsdo zhing rigs la snyegs pa dang*/ lus la sbrul ltar 'khril ba dang*/ mgo la skra ltar du za ba dang*/ mig ngan gyi ce re lta ba dang*/ kha ngan du smra ba dang*/ bsam pa ngan pa dung nge sems pa dang*/ bsgral ba'i zhing bcu la gtogs pa thams cad rig sngags 'dis bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// tho bas brdung ngo*/ phyag rgyas mnan no// na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra nāṃ/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya gha tā ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya/ bdag la snga dgra sdang ba dang*/ phyi dgra sems pa thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa phaṭa/ kī li kī lā ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya/ badz+ra dha rod a dzñā pa ya ti/ kā ya wa tsit+ta badz+ra kī lā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kro dhe ka mud+ga ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa/ bi dhā sa ya bi dh+waṃ sa ya/ dza ṭi lam+bo dha ri u tsush+ma kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ gzungs 'di yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ sa la btab nas 'gas/ brag la btab na brag snyil/ shang la btab na shing skem/ chu la btab na chu chad/ me la btab na me 'chi/ rlung la btab na rlung chad/ rnam par shes pa'i lus can rnams la smos ci dgos/ de nas rdo rje sder mos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bdag sngon byung ba'i dus na bskal pa grangs med pa'i pha rol tu bud med kyi lus blangs ba'i dus su bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon cha'i rgyal po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byon te/
